triggerInfo:
This workflow has the following trigger(s):


Webhook trigger(s):


				<trigger 1>
					 - Node name: Trigger: Retell Call
					 - Base URL: https://dragandanevski.app.n8n.cloud/
					 - Production path: /webhook/retell-call-ended
					 - Test path: /webhook-test/retell-call-ended
					 - HTTP Method: POST
					 - Response Mode: Webhook is configured to respond immediately with the message "Workflow got started."
					 - No credentials required for this webhook.
				</trigger 1>

Form trigger(s):


				<trigger 1>
					 - Node name: On form submission
					 - Form fields: {"values":[{"fieldLabel":"Name"},{"fieldLabel":"Company name"},{"fieldLabel":"Email","fieldType":"email"},{"fieldLabel":"Phone Number","fieldType":"number"},{"fieldLabel":"Question"}]}
				</trigger 1>

Use the following input format when directly executing this workflow using any of the form triggers: { inputs { formData: Array<{ FIELD_NAME: VALUE }> } }
